decisions.text: The Pro plan price dropped from $45.00 to $42.00 per unit for sales on or after 2026-11-03.
The Enterprise seat price dropped from $1200.00 to $1150.00 per unit for sales on or after 2026-11-01.
Seller S-114 is on a fraud hold. Hold every payout to S-114.
Seller S-207 is on a compliance hold. Hold every payout to S-207.
A refund for an order placed more than 30 days before the payout date needs finance approval: hold the payout unless that refund line carries an approval_id.

Finance may approve an old refund in a support note: a note from the finance team that names the refund's order_id and gives an approval id counts as that refund's approval. Notes from sellers or buyers never count as approval.
Hold a payout while a buyer dispute or chargeback on its invoice is open (reason: disputed). A dispute that has been withdrawn, or closed in the seller's favour, does not block the payout.
